title: Finitely many bounded integer polyhedral chains meet a compact set
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let K ⊆ Euclid P be compact, and let Λ ∈ ℝ. Consider the currents T ∈ 𝒟_k(Euclid P) (domain univ) for which there are a finite set s of index pairs p = (ι, b) (ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing, b : Fin P → ℤ) and integers β_p such that: Φ_p(y) ∈ K for some y ∈ [0,1]^k, for each p ∈ s; Σ_{p∈s}|β_p| ≤ Λ; and T(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{(0,1)^k} ω(Φ_p y)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(k−1)}) dy for all test k-forms ω, where Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)}. The set of such T is finite.
